english.note: Use this when emphasizing the ability to perceive underlying truths or relationships.
Use this when emphasizing deep insight into the reasons or meaning beneath what is obvious.

examples.english: They are very insightful and can spot the root of the problem at a glance.
examples.traditional: 佢好有洞察力，一眼就睇到問題嘅根源。

examples.english: She is very perceptive when analyzing problems and does not just look at the surface.
examples.traditional: 佢分析問題好有洞察力，唔會只係睇表面。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 fan1 sik1 man6 tai4 hou2 jau5 dung6 caat3 lik6 m4 wui5 zi2 hai6 tai2 biu2 min6
